section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining body appreciation in adult women from the Portuguese general population (N = 288). The study used path analysis to explore how self-compassionate engagement and action competences impact body appreciation, with psychological flexibility as a potential mediator. The research suggests that combining Compassion Focused Therapy and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy strategies may promote positive body image in adult women.
